purpose: Normative RTF ANSI code-page handling: decode raw Windows-1252 bytes declared by \ansicpg1252, then normalise Unicode punctuation.
authority: Normative Cochrane Ovid MEDLINE-to-PubMed Conversion Rules v20
reference_v20_v2_note: The current v20-v2 maintenance implementation reads RTF with strict UTF-8 and is expected to fail on the raw Windows-1252 byte in this fixture. The implementation must be corrected; do not weaken the fixture.
